briefing.title: Farm Watch
briefing.question: How healthy are the crops of the Nile Delta, and how much water do they use?
briefing.description: Farmers need to know which fields are thriving and which are thirsty. Build a spacecraft that can see single fields from space.

source.title: NASA Landsat Science, Operational Land Imager
source.detail: 30 m imagery is described as sufficient to distinguish features such as urban centres, farms and forests. Budget, deadline and duration are scenario settings.

deltaVSource.title: NASA Basics of Space Flight, Chapter 14
deltaVSource.detail: Game assumes direct launcher insertion into the selected Earth science orbit. It budgets zero post-separation maneuver delta-v and omits orbit maintenance.

briefing.title: Moon Landing
briefing.question: What can we learn from the Moon's terrain?
briefing.description: Take a crew to the Moon, study the terrain, and bring the crew home.

source.title: NASA Orion Reference Guide
source.detail: Orion exploration mission and crew module. Crew of two on the surface follows Apollo. Budget, deadline, and game duration are scenario settings.

suppliesSource.title: NASA/TM-2004-212940
suppliesSource.detail: Fig. 1 metabolic inputs: 0.84 oxygen + 0.62 dry food + 1.15 water in food + 0.76 meal preparation water + 1.62 drinking water. Excludes hygiene and recycling.

deltaVSource.title: Lunar Operations Delta V Budget
deltaVSource.detail: Table 3, p. 24. Derived spacecraft burns: 60 outbound correction + 915 lunar insertion + 2165 descent + 1920 ascent + 915 Earth return injection + 60 return correction. Launcher provides translunar injection. Atmospheric return to Earth omits circularization and station rendezvous.

downlinkSource.title: NASA Optical Communications for Artemis II Crewed Mission
downlinkSource.detail: Mission Objectives table: nominal 80 Mbps return. The game assumes 30 minutes per day of usable contact.

briefing.title: Mars Sample Drones
briefing.question: Where should a rover and scout look for samples?
briefing.description: Land a rover or drone, scout for interesting terrain, and investigate possible sample sites.

source.title: JPL Mars 2020 Launch Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts, rover and helicopter. Budget, deadline, and game duration are scenario settings.

deltaVSource.title: NASA Mars Helicopter Attached to Perseverance
deltaVSource.detail: Powered descent minimum: 80 - 0.75 = 79.25 m/s, rounded up to 80. Add a 20 m/s game allowance for cruise corrections based on Spirit's 14.3 m/s first correction (JPL, June 20, 2003). Omits gravity losses, divert and flyaway. Launcher provides transfer injection.

downlinkSource.title: NASA Mars Relay Network
downlinkSource.detail: The rover-to-orbiter link operates at up to 2 Mbps. The game assumes 30 minutes per day of usable relay contact.

briefing.title: Storm Chasers
briefing.question: How much rain falls inside tropical storms?
briefing.description: Tropical storms bring floods. Build a spacecraft that can measure rain from above, even through thick cloud.

briefing.title: Ice Patrol
briefing.question: Are the polar ice sheets getting thinner?
briefing.description: The great ice sheets sit near the poles. Build a spacecraft that can measure the height of the ice, year after year.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: ICESat mission and GLAS, PDF p. 176-177. ICESat's 94 degree orbit reaches latitude 86 degrees. Budget, deadline and duration are scenario settings.
